name: Summer Arts at Derby Academy
description_short: Half-day (9:00 AM–12:00 PM) arts programs for ages 8–15 at Derby Academy in Hingham, covering theater, tech theater, visual arts, culinary arts and dance. Each session ends with a showcase or gallery.

warnings: The page is for the summer 2026 season (URL path '/summer2026/'), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 information was found.

The theater dates have no year. June 28 and July 26, 2026 are Sundays, and July 16 and August 13, 2026 are Thursdays. In 2027 the same dates run Monday to Friday, so they may be copied from another year. I recorded them as 2026, but check them with the camp.

This page covers only the Summer Arts part of Derby Academy's summer programs, which also include Camp Derby, STEM and Sports. It is not clear whether Summer Arts can be booked on its own or whether it is a morning block inside the full-day camp.
No dates are given for any program except the Theater Pathway. Some programs have two age groups (8-11 and 12-15), and those are combined in a single entry.
